paper_metadata.title: A high-strength extruded Mg–Gd–Zn–Zr alloy with superplasticity

evidence.quote: This article presents an extruded Mg–Gd–Zn–Zr alloy produced by conventional ingot metallurgy, exhibiting high-strength and excellent ductility at room and elevated temperatures.

It was solution-treated at 773 K for 35 h in a SX2-8-10-type high-temperature heat treatment furnace (Changzhou Nuoji Instrument Co., Changzhou, China) and immediately quenched in cold water.
Then, the solution-treated ingot was extruded with an extrusion ratio of 6.25 at temperature of 623 K.
